corrected_text: In LiteRT-LM's MTP, a standard round's verify run takes the token being extended plus the 3 drafts at positions p..p+3, and the number of accepted drafts is the longest prefix on which the drafts equal the verifier's greedy picks (CountAcceptedPrefix, for every kind of round); the round emits the accepted drafts plus the verifier's next pick as a bonus token, and current_step advances by that count. Running the drafter's steps as one GPU chain (ours: 1109d46c, on by default since c137900d, 2026-11-17) leaves this rule unchanged.
